theme.rationale: Light theme preferred for e-commerce to ensure clear product visibility and build trust. Fits the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype for a premium, archival, and blueprint-like functional aesthetic.

headings.guidelines: Use tracking-tight for all headings above text-2xl. Use bold or black weights for editorial impact. 'Inter' is banned for headings.

body.guidelines: Clean, technical, highly readable for dense attribute data and product descriptions.

labels.guidelines: Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] for overlines, tags, and small utility text.

colors.guidelines: Follow the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. 95% of UI is monochrome. Color exists only to guide action (Signal Orange for 'Buy Now' / 'Make Offer'). Never use pure black or pure gray; tint with a subtle warmth.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton with visible grid borders. Use flat solid surfaces. Avoid glassmorphism entirely to maintain a raw, transparent marketplace feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border everywhere. Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
visual_enhancers.shadows: No soft shadows. Use solid, harsh shadows (e.g., 2px solid black offset) or none at all to maintain the archival/blueprint aesthetic.

components.navigation: Solid white background with 1px bottom border. Search bar must be the focal point and highly visible. Do not hide desktop links behind a hamburger menu.
components.product_card: Cardless UI. Image container with a 1px border. Product info directly below. No background on the info section. High contrast text.
components.buttons: Sharp corners. Primary CTA uses Signal Orange. Secondary CTA uses outline (1px solid black) with transparent background, hover black background with white text.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to have sharp corners (rounded-none) and 1px solid black border on focus.
components.badges: Square corners, text-xs, uppercase, solid background for condition (e.g., 'BRAND NEW', 'GENTLY USED').

grids_and_layouts.general: High Density Grid (Mode B) for discovery and product lists. Use gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing for layout containers (p-8 to p-12). Dense spacing for data and attributes to reflect 'Information clarity, functional beauty'.
grids_and_layouts.product_page: Split layout for desktop: 60% sticky image gallery (left) / 40% scrollable info and checkout actions (right).

motion.guidelines: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for feedback. Hover on product images scales image slightly (1.05) within hidden overflow container. Fast, snappy transitions (150ms).

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use data-testid attributes for all interactive elements. Support prefers-reduced-motion.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern, sharp/technical styles with relevant interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Ensure layered design elements with clear z-index hierarchy.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-contrast, technical grid aesthetic. Emphasize functional clarity over decorative elements. Ensure all UI components follow the 'Cardless' and 'Grid Borders' approach. Prioritize the search experience. Build a mobile-first responsive design. For React components, ensure direct children are used in grid layouts. Every interactive element must have a data-testid. Do not use transparent backgrounds under text-heavy components.
